$description: Wingtip Maps' screens and the one link that opens each, the source for the web, iOS and Android (docs/navigation.md). A link is the web app's own address, https://<host>/app/plan?open=<id>, with the plan's own keys beside it (dep, dest, stops, place, flight); the phones take the same address as a universal link or App Link, and as wingtipmaps://plan?open=<id> from another app. scripts/build/screens.sh generates apps/web/src/lib/navigation/generated/screens.ts, apps/ios/Wingtip/Navigation/Generated/Screens.swift, apps/android/app/src/main/kotlin/app/wingtipmaps/android/navigation/generated/Screens.kt and docs/navigation.md's table of links from it; CI generates them again and fails on a difference. Each app opens a screen it has in one exhaustive switch over the generated list, so a screen added here fails each app's build until that app opens it. Add a screen here, never in a generated file. A screen's "shortcut" is its place among Android's app shortcuts (res/xml/shortcuts.xml) and the web app manifest's shortcuts (apps/web/src/lib/navigation/generated/manifest-shortcuts.json): the launcher's long press shows the first four, and Google's assistant opens each by its title (App Actions, OPEN_APP_FEATURE); a screen that needs something to open with has none. Its "shortLabel" is the launcher's short label where the title is over ten characters (the long label is the title, 25 at most).

params.about: A field's card, by its ident.
An airplane tracked, by its ICAO address (six hex digits).
An airplane's profile, by its N-number.
A temporary flight restriction's card, by its FDC NOTAM number (6/4116).
A shared plan's cruise altitude, feet MSL.
A shared plan's departure time, an ISO 8601 instant in UTC; none for about now.
A shared plan's airplane type, its designator (C172); shown, never assumed: the receiver flies their own.
A shared plan's flight rules, vfr or ifr.
A shared plan's N-number, only where its pilot chose to send it.
A saved flight shared by its pilot, by its token (GET /api/shared-flights/{token}); read-only, until they stop sharing it.
